page_title: LYO 1-0 NIC | Lyon v Nice 16/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' Some patient build-up play from Lyon as they look to unlock the defence.
90+1' Aliou Balde (Nice) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lyon.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
88' Maxence Caqueret provides the assist in the box, but Rayan Cherki (Lyon) places his shot a fraction wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
88' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) climbs high to connect with a perfect cross and produces a header that goes not far wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
88' The ball is out of play and Nice manage to earn a corner.
87' Gift Orban (Lyon) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
86' Jeremie Boga (Nice) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt.
84' Jeremie Boga (Nice) jinks his way past multiple challenges and fires the ball from the edge of the box to the right side of the goal, but Anthony Lopes shows his agility and makes a save.
84' Jean-Clair Todibo (Nice) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
82' The foul by Jordan Lotomba (Nice) was seen by Clement Turpin who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Lyon have a free kick.
82' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
81' Substitution. Mohamed-Ali Cho makes way for Aliou Balde (Nice).
79' Here is a change. Ernest Nuamah is going off and Pierre Sage gives the last tactical orders to Rayan Cherki (Lyon).
78' The linesman raises his flag. Jeremie Boga (Nice) is adjudged offside.
76' Jeremie Boga (Nice) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
76' Melvin Bard (Nice) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Nice earn a corner.
74' Substitution. Malick Fofana (Lyon) in, Orel Mangala out.
74' Pierre Sage has decided to make a change. Gift Orban (Lyon) replaces Said Benrahma.
73' Melvin Bard (Nice) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Terem Moffi, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
72' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom left corner and forces a good save out of Anthony Lopes.
71' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tom Louchet (Nice) replaces Morgan Sanson.

69' Morgan Sanson sends a lovely ball from the corner into the path of Pablo Rosario (Nice), whose close-range header flashes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
69' Morgan Sanson (Nice) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
68' The free kick from Morgan Sanson (Nice) is cleared away from danger by one of the defenders. Nice force a corner. They send men into the box.

67' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Clement Turpin blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. Nice win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
65' There's a distinct lack of options for Orel Mangala (Lyon), so he drills a shot from long range that curls well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.

64' The ball spins to Terem Moffi (Nice) on the edge of the box. He hits across the ball and sends it goalwards, but it goes just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Lyon will have a goal kick.
63' A cross into the box from Jeremie Boga (Nice) is cleared.
62' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) threads a pass through to Said Benrahma, but Marcin Bulka breaks up the move.
62' Nice enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alexis Claude-Maurice (Nice) comes onto the pitch so that Youssouf Ndayishimiye can be given a rest.
59' Francesco Farioli has decided to substitute Gaetan Laborde and he is replaced by Jeremie Boga (Nice).
59' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Evann Guessand as he is replaced by Terem Moffi (Nice).
57' Great teamplay by Lyon as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
54' A fine solo run by Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
53' Clement Turpin blows his whistle as Duje Caleta-Car (Lyon) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. A free kick has been awarded to Nice.
53' Said Benrahma (Lyon) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.

53' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Lyon.
52' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
51' Alexandre Lacazette receives a sweet cross inside the box from Said Benrahma (Lyon), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
50' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) commits a rough foul. Clement Turpin stops the game and makes a call. A free kick is awarded to Lyon.
49' The resulting corner, taken by Morgan Sanson (Nice), comes to nothing.
49' Jordan Lotomba (Nice) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Nice.
48' Melvin Bard (Nice) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Anthony Lopes, who smothers the ball.
47' Clinton Mata (Lyon) whips a volley from long range towards the goal. His beautiful effort whistles wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
47' Said Benrahma (Lyon) works the corner short.
46' Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Lyon have a corner.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+1' A cross is whipped into the box by Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) and Evann Guessand controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.

43' Anthony Lopes makes a brilliant save! Khephren Thuram (Nice) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the right side of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
42' Orel Mangala (Lyon) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. That's a free kick to Nice.
41' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
41' Lyon are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
39' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
38' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) whips the ball into the box and Alexandre Lacazette takes a perfect touch to control it, but one of the defenders does well to intercept.
38' Lyon can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
37' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Lyon have been awarded a corner kick.
37' Wonderful pass from Khephren Thuram (Nice) for Evann Guessand, but they can't profit from it as Anthony Lopes comes off his line to collect.
36' Said Benrahma (Lyon) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball goes out of play and Nice will have a goal kick.
36' The corner from Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) is hurriedly cleared.
35' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Lyon win a corner.
34' Khephren Thuram (Nice) tries to find Evann Guessand, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
33' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) tries to find Ainsley Maitland-Niles, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
31' Maxence Caqueret (Lyon) shoots after receiving a good pass. His effort from the edge of the box goes just wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Nice.
29' Shots on target – 1:2.
26' The Nice players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
22' 1 - 0 Goal - 1:0! Ernest Nuamah laid the ball off to Orel Mangala (Lyon), who shot from close range into the top of the net, leaving the goalkeeper helpless.
22' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) launches a cross from the corner, but Anthony Lopes is alert to thwart the effort.
21' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Nice.
21' Gaetan Laborde (Nice) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. Nice get a corner.
20' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

20' Morgan Sanson (Nice) collects a simple pass and decides to shoot from distance. It's a swerving effort aimed towards the bottom left corner, but Anthony Lopes reads it well and makes a comfortable save. Nice force their opponents to concede a corner.
18' The resulting corner from Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) comes to nothing.

17' Wow, what an escape. Morgan Sanson (Nice) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The ball goes behind for a corner. Nice will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.

16' Khephren Thuram (Nice) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team. Lyon have been awarded a free kick.
15' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) commits a rough challenge and Clement Turpin blows his whistle for a foul. Nice win a free kick.
15' The possession of the ball – 50:50.

10' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
9' Youssouf Ndayishimiye (Nice) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
9' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) misses a great chance to score after his effort hits the right post!
8' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
6' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
6' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Gaetan Laborde (Nice) inside the box. The referee signals a corner kick to Nice.
5' Mohamed-Ali Cho (Nice) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his low effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Anthony Lopes.
5' The Nice players are exchanging some short passes.
4' Evann Guessand (Nice) attempts to release Gaetan Laborde with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
3' An attempted cross from Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) is cleared.
1' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
1' The first half has just begun.
Nice will kick the game off.
Clement Turpin will referee today's match.
